title: The Colt in the Mud
offer: Silke's colt ran into the bog and is stuck to his belly! I need a long rope: Tor in Stormvik has the longest. Hurry, he is scared!

steps.load_say: My longest rope! Take it, quick!
steps.say: Rope around him, gently, everybody pull... Slurp! He is out! Muddy, but well. You saved him.

fact: A horse stuck in mud must be pulled out slowly, or it hurts its legs.
